dashboard.notes: Native workspace is served at /workspace. Lifecycle close/delete returns to Jobs; UK/NZ lists provide select-all-shown and bulk deletion with per-record cleanup, progress and partial-result reporting. NZ has role/location search and optional advanced imports. Country ownership, factual-document checks and final assisted-browser approval are retained.

pipeline.notes: Native discovery uses live draft-aware scope preview and exact-plan review. Default caps: 50 matching new jobs, 10 results per board/portal search, new-run-only enrichment/scoring; Workday/direct providers opt in. Shared cross-source budget and reserved run memberships prevent backlog processing. Campaign snapshot identity remains canonical; legacy CLI path is retained.
